1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (same as the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate).
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the same sample as the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate (16-month OPRA data, 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for the OOS exp/tr calculation. The sample is fixed and the selection method is the same signal (vwap_continuation) at ITM-2 strike. Overfit risk is low because we are only varying DTE and not optimizing parameters.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we are computing OOS exp/tr by definition, but we need to run the backfill to get the number; we will use the same OOS window as the candidate: 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we will use the real OPRA fills simulator for the backfill).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if the trend reverses at longer DTE (e.g., due to increased gap risk or theta decay patterns), we could see lower exp/tr. Max drawdown: unknown until backfill. 6. **Concentration:** We will compute the concentration after the backfill. We expect it to be similar to the 2DTE case (drop-top3 near full mean) because the held-overnight % is ~0 at -8% stop.
